remediation.reason: fixture — vérification RouterOS 7, aucune mesure réelle revendiquée
remediation.routeros:
# CGO remediation - RouterOS v7+
# Requires RouterOS >= 7.10 for kind=cake. Verify with: /system resource print
# Sized from a measured 20.00 Mbit/s bottleneck and 25 ms idle RTT.
# Shaped at 95% of measured rate (19000000 bit/s) to stay below the real bottleneck.
# Idempotent: removes its own objects before recreating them.

/queue tree remove [find where comment="cgo-managed"]
/queue type remove [find where name~"^cgo-"]

/queue type add name=cgo-cake kind=cake \
    cake-bandwidth=19000000 cake-rtt=25ms \
    cake-flowmode=triple-isolate cake-nat=yes cake-diffserv=diffserv4 \
    cake-ack-filter=filter cake-wash=yes

/queue tree add name=cgo-wan-out parent=ether1-wan max-limit=19000000 \
    queue=cgo-cake comment="cgo-managed"
remediation.routeros_ingress:
# CGO download remediation - RouterOS v7+
# RouterOS has no IFB. This is a queue tree on the LAN/private
# interface, which is where download traffic egresses toward clients.
# It shapes the same direction at a different point than the Linux IFB.
# Requires RouterOS >= 7.10 for kind=cake. Verify with: /system resource print
# Sized from a measured 20.00 Mbit/s bottleneck and 25 ms idle RTT.
# Shaped at 95% of measured rate (19000000 bit/s) to stay below the real bottleneck.
# Idempotent: removes its own objects before recreating them.

/queue tree remove [find where comment="cgo-managed-ingress"]
/queue type remove [find where name~"^cgoingress-"]

# No ack-filter: a download data stream is not an ACK stream.

/queue type add name=cgoingress-cake kind=cake \
    cake-bandwidth=19000000 cake-rtt=25ms \
    cake-flowmode=dual-dsthost cake-nat=yes cake-diffserv=diffserv4 \
    cake-wash=yes

/queue tree add name=cgoingress-lan-in parent=ether2-lan max-limit=19000000 \
    queue=cgoingress-cake comment="cgo-managed-ingress"
